method: Real gameplay with process-local keyboard, mouse and event inputs. Native framebuffer copied through SFML Texture and Image APIs, then encoded as WebP at quality 88 unless an entry specifies otherwise.
notes: Game logic, board state, clocks, random results and assets were not modified.
Captures used the existing game installations with sfml.js 1.0.0-rc.2; they do not claim an upgrade of those projects to 1.0.0.
Every image was visually inspected after play. Frame and elapsed-time values identify the captured frame.
Source and asset ownership remain with their respective authors; these screenshots do not relicense game assets.

16-games.origin: ClojureScript + sfml.js ports of jsyqrt/games, originally C++ + SFML

node-sfml-demos.launch: node index.js from the game's own directory

super-mario-kart.launch: npm start from the repository root
super-mario-kart.origin: TypeScript + sfml.js port of vmbatlle/super-mario-kart, originally C++ + SFML 2.5.1

screenshots.inputs: Confirm Grand Prix, 50cc and Mario with Enter, skip the flyover, then hold X to accelerate.
screenshots.progress: Mario drove from normalized position (0.109375, 0.69140625) to (0.109375, 0.511599600315094) on Donut Plains 1; moving at capture, ranked sixth of eight.
screenshots.capture: Existing compiled game running its real 60 Hz loop; process-local input hooks only. Player control type, physics, clock and AI unchanged. Preferences were not saved.
